rows.description: Earth/soundscape parity uses deterministic generated coverage; embedding decoded OGG nature textures in Core remains a product/performance decision.

evidence: no idle piano scheduler without notes
rows.description: Browser Core mode exposes worklet CPU telemetry and bounds host piano sample memory/CPU work to active piano paths.
Native CPU-sensitive paths are guarded by the existing mobile audio hotpath audit.

Drum source has native Core module coverage, browser acceptance gates, Webapp control methods, and Core preview playback for clock/swing/trigger/probability/trig/ratchet/expression/morph/distance/pitch overrides.
Lead 1/2 use the Core Lead FM module for manual and synth-Euclid preview paths.
Native state and audio graph contain the current parity-critical source, sequencer, and shared-delay surfaces.
Pad and Pad 2 have native Core module routing and browser acceptance coverage.

evidence: Core worklet external FX input buses
rows.description: Sampled host piano now keeps its dry bridge and routes wet sends through Core worklet reverb, Delay A, Delay B, and granular input buses.
Sampled piano stays host-side for CPU and sample-decode safety, but Core mode now triggers it instead of going silent.
Pad, lead, drum, soundscape, Delay A/B, granular, reverb, spectral freeze, dynamics paths are covered by module and corpus gates.
Water/nature soundscape paths route through the Core soundscapes module for browser parity.

evidence: Core host Synth Euclid API bridge
rows.description: CoreHost exposes the Webapp Synth Euclid control API, runs bar-boundary live evolve, and applies trigger, pitch, expression, probability, trig, ratchet, piano distance, and per-note lead/pad morph-distance overrides in Core preview playback.
Core mode recognizes the same synth-Euclid source family as the Webapp, including piano and pad voice lanes.
CoreHost now owns every audioEngine method the Webapp calls, so Core mode no longer depends on runtime proxy fallbacks for app-level controls.
